content:
**Bullet Shield** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*. 

While firing a heavy gun, increases Deflect chance by 5% per rank, up to 20%. Stacks additively with other Deflect chance bonuses. Effect persists for 6 second.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★★ | 4 | Gain 20% Deflect chance for 6 sec when firing a heavy gun. | 00320160 | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Gain 15% Deflect chance for 6 sec when firing a heavy gun. | 0032015F | 
| ★★ | 2 | Gain 10% Deflect chance for 6 sec when firing a heavy gun. | 0032015E | 
| ★ | 1 | Gain 5% Deflect chance for 6 sec when firing a heavy gun. | 0032015D | 

Update 56 increased this perk's available ranks from 3 to 4, moved it from Strength to Endurance, and changed its effect. Previously, it provided 20/40/60 Damage Resistance when firing a heavy gun.
